title: Xaroba Sardori endi yerda yuradi: qadam tashlaydi, har qadamda chang ko'tariladi

steps.eval: const r=window.__realm,s=r.sim,p=r.me.p; r.view.panel='none'; p.takeHit=()=>false; p.x=160*16+8; p.y=108*16+8; p.fx=1; p.fy=0; s.mobs=s.mobs.filter(m=>m.kind==='warden'); const w=s.mobs[0]; w.spawnT=0; w.state='chase'; w.target='me'; setInterval(()=>{ w.cd=9; if(w.state!=='chase'){w.state='chase';w.target='me';} p.x=Math.max(152*16, p.x-1.5); p.fx=1; }, 50);
